title: 18th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/18/2/2025).
First reading of the government-sponsored bill, submitted by Dhidhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed, to amend Law No. 8/2020 (Water and Sewerage Act).

First reading of a resolution submitted by Hulhumalé South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed, seeking members' views on the heavy cost of electricity and water services borne by small and medium businesses operating in areas other than Malé.
First reading of a bill submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to amend Law No. 9/2014 (Maldives Penal Code).
Preliminary debate on the government-sponsored bill, submitted by Dhidhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed, to amend Law No. 8/2020 (Water and Sewerage Act).

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim, seeking members' views on the prolonged, unresolved problems arising from the K-Park Residence housing project started in Hulhumalé.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to introduce three new items (a Water and Sewerage Act amendment, a resolution on utility costs for small businesses outside Malé, and a Penal Code amendment), begin debating the water bill, and continue the K-Park Residence resolution debate.
